en.hubeali: H 15041 – And by this chain, from Anbasat, from Moalla Bin Khunays who said:

‘I was in the presence of Abu Abdullahasws when Muhammad Bin Abdullah came up and greeted, then went away. Abu Abdullahasws sympathised and tears flowed from hisasws eyes. So I said to himasws, ‘I saw youasws doing something what you never did for anyone before’. Heasws said; ‘Iasws sympathised for him because he will be established upon a command which is not for him. Iasws did not find him in the Book of Aliasws from the Caliphs of this community, nor from its kings’.
en.sarwar: 595. Ali Bin Ibrahim, by an unbroken chain, said:

‘Abu Abdullah (a.s.) said to a man: ‘What are considered to be the young ones (Al-Fati) among you?’ He said to him (a.s.), ‘The youth’. So he (a.s.) said; ‘No! Al-Fati is the Believer. The Companions of the Cave (As’haab Al-Kahf) were old people, Allah (azwj) Mighty and Majestic Called them ‘Young men’ due to their belief’.
